data.title: Experimental determination of the nuclear magnetic octupole moment of 137Ba+ ion
data.authors: Lewty, N. C.; Chuah, B. L.; Cazan, R.; Barrett, M. D.; Sahoo, B. K.
data.notes: Precision RF spectroscopy of a single trapped 137Ba+ ion. Reports hyperfine A, B, C constants for both 5D5/2 (Table 2) and 5D3/2 (Table 6, Appendix C) manifolds with Hz-level accuracy. Corrections for second-order hyperfine perturbations applied. Nuclear magnetic dipole moment mu_I = 0.937365(20) mu_N cited (from Werth, Physica Scripta T59, 206, 1995). Also reports nuclear magnetic octupole moment.

properties.notes: Corrected for second-order hyperfine perturbations (eta and zeta corrections applied). J=5/2 so B constant valid.

Corrected for second-order hyperfine perturbations. J=3/2 so B constant valid. These 5D3/2 values supersede Lewty et al. 2012 (OE 20, 21379) which gives slightly different values; the 2013 PRA paper includes additional corrections.
